name: DocuVision v1 Generic (intake / task.completed callback / result fetch)

parameters.content:
## Flow A — Intake

Sources checked against the repo (as-of 2026-11-15, branch feat/r003-p042-egress):

- `POST /api/v1/upload` — multipart, `file` required (backend/tests/snapshots/openapi_baseline.json → components.schemas.Body_upload_file_api_v1_upload_post.required). Response has NO response_model in the OpenAPI snapshot (200 schema {}); actual keys come from the handler: task_id / file_name / status:"uploaded" / message / page_count (backend/app/routers/analyzer.py:130-136).
- `POST /api/v1/analyze` — multipart, `file` required, all other Form fields optional with backend defaults (backend/app/routers/analyzer.py:140-174). Response model = TaskStatus, required: task_id / status / progress / message / created_at (backend/tests/snapshots/openapi_baseline.json → components.schemas.TaskStatus).
- The two branches run in parallel on purpose: the task_id returned by /upload is preview-only (analyzer.py:88 docstring: "only uploads the file without processing, allowing immediate preview"); /analyze always accepts its own file and creates a NEW task_id (analyzer.py:202). No endpoint consumes the /upload task_id to start processing.
- Boolean Form fields: FastAPI parses "1"/"0" as True/False; the strings "true"/"false" cause 422 (comment at backend/app/routers/analyzer.py:181-182). This template sends only `file` so backend defaults apply.

## Flow B — task.completed callback

- Webhook receives the dispatch body {event, payload, timestamp} (backend/app/services/webhook_service.py:138).
- payload fields per dispatch site: task_id / file_name / status / validation_passed (backend/app/orchestration/steps/governance.py:120-127). status is always "completed" here (governance.py:85). validation_passed comes from (result.get("kie_validation") or {}).get("validation_passed") — may be null when KIE is off.
- DocuVision dispatches ONLY two events: task.completed and batch.completed (webhook_service.py:73, 94). There is no failure callback — poll GET /api/v1/tasks/{task_id} for status "failed".
- GET /api/v1/tasks/{task_id}/result returns 400 "Task not completed" unless status is "succeeded" or "completed", 404 if unknown task (backend/app/routers/tasks_content.py:30-37). Safe to call right after task.completed because status is already "completed" (governance.py:85, persisted governance.py:113).
- HMAC signature: header X-DocuVision-Signature = HMAC-SHA256(secret, raw body) hex (webhook_service.py:146-147). See README: byte-exact verification works in-n8n via the Webhook node's options.rawBody (n8n source Webhook.node.ts:338-356 exposes base64 raw bytes in binary.data); the templates ship without the verify node.

## Flow C — one-off subscription registration

`POST /api/v1/webhooks` gates (backend/app/routers/webhooks.py:57-77):

1. Backend env WEBHOOK_ENABLED=true (default false, alias DOCUVISION_WEBHOOK_ENABLED — backend/app/core/config.py:102-105); otherwise dispatch silently returns [] (webhook_service.py:129-130).
2. Header X-DocuVision-Admin-Token must equal WEBHOOK_ADMIN_TOKEN (config.py:106-109); empty token fail-closes with 401 (webhooks.py:24-46, raise at :45).
3. Request is application/x-www-form-urlencoded: url required, events default "task.completed,batch.completed", secret default "" (openapi_baseline → Body_register_webhook_api_v1_webhooks_post). 200 returns {subscription_id, url, events}.
4. SSRF gate: URLs on loopback/private networks are rejected with 400 (webhook_service.py:21-30, 89-90 → webhooks.py:71-72). $env.DOCUVISION_CALLBACK_URL must be a non-loopback address reachable from the DocuVision host — a same-machine localhost n8n URL will be rejected (see README known issues).

Run this flow once per environment; token/secret are injected via n8n env vars, never stored in the template.
